// Grammar for the rule language. The parser module calc/_parser.py is generated from this file.
?start: expr
?expr: expr "+" term   -> add
     | expr "-" term   -> sub
     | term
?term: term "*" atom   -> mul
     | term "/" atom   -> div
     | atom
?atom: NUMBER          -> num
     | "ture"          -> true
     | "false"         -> false
     | "(" expr ")"
NUMBER: /[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?/
%ignore " "
